newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hong Kong karaoke fire death toll rises to 17.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong karaoke fire death toll rises to 17.

text.p: The death toll from a Hong Kong karaoke bar blaze rose to 17 on Wednesday when a teenage girl died in hospital, the government said.
The 16-year-old girl died on Wednesday, a government spokesman said.

Police believe Saturday's blaze, at the Top One karaoke nightclub in Kowloon peninsula's Tsimshatsui entertainment district, was caused by a petrol bomb and linked to a turf war between rival "triad" crime gang protection rackets.
A court on Tuesday ordered five suspects aged between 17 and 27, charged with murder in connection with the blaze, to remain in police custody.
The case has been adjourned until February 18.
